name: Victorian
what_it_means: Victorian design draws on 19th-century print and interiors: ornate frames, flourishes, damask patterns, engraved illustrations, blackletter and decorative serifs, rich burgundy, forest green and gold. It conveys heritage, craftsmanship and old-world romance.
signature_moves: Rich dark palette: burgundy, green, gold, cream
best_for: Tea, whisky, perfumers, bookshops, heritage & antique brands
prompt_template: B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ] ** Design a homepage for [HERITAGE BRAND, e.g. tea merchant] in a Victorian style. Dark burgundy background (#2B0F14) with a subtle damask wallpaper pattern. Centre a cream (#F2E6CC) label panel inside an ornate gold (#C9A54C) double frame with corner flourishes. Headline in blackletter (UnifrakturMaguntia), subheads in a decorative serif (Playfair / IM Fell) with small caps, 'Est. 1887' seal, engraved-style illustration and ornamental dividers ( ❦ ). Buttons look like printed tickets with scalloped edges. Muted forest green (#1F3B2D) for secondary blocks.
